title: Pure Speedroid
summary: Pure Speedroid and Clear Wing WIND Synchro deck centered on Yugo's high-speed mechanical toys, utilizing modern 2025 support to assemble devastating Synchro dragons without external engines like Runick. Tight WIND-locking starters ladder seamlessly into multi-negate dragon bosses and board wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Speedroid Terrortop Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters, and searches any Speedroid monster from your Deck on summon without using your Normal Summon.
Speedroid Taketomborg Special Summons itself from hand while you control a WIND monster, and tributes itself to Special Summon any Speedroid Tuner directly from your Deck.

Speedroid Darumaknocker sends a Speedroid card from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand, searches a Speedroid Spell or Trap when sent from field to GY, and destroys an opponent's monster while you control a Clear Wing monster.
Speedroid Colonel Clackers banishes a Speedroid from GY to place Speedroid Wing Synchron in the Pendulum Zone, and Special Summons itself as a Tuner when destroyed on the field.

summary.title: Opening: Speedroid Terrortop
steps: Special Summon Speedroid Terrortop from your hand while controlling no monsters.
Activate Terrortop's on-summon effect to search Speedroid Taketomborg from your Deck.
Special Summon Speedroid Taketomborg from your hand, then tribute it to Special Summon Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice from your Deck.
Activate Red-Eyed Dice's effect targeting Terrortop to adjust Terrortop's Level to 6.
Synchro Summon Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, then tune it with Hi-Speedroid Cork Shooter (a Level 3 Synchro Tuner) into Level 10 Crystal Clear Wing Synchro Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Crystal Clear Wing Synchro Dragon becomes unaffected by an opposing monster's activated effect and gains that monster's ATK, and negates and destroys a Spell/Trap activation once per turn. Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon is Forbidden since October 2026.
Crystal Clear Wing Over Synchro Dragon negates any card or effect once per turn, cannot be destroyed by opponent card effects, and floats into Clear Wing Synchro Dragon if removed by the opponent.
Crystal Clear Wing Synchro Dragon negates an opponent's Spell or Trap Card or effect and destroys it, while ignoring opponent monster effects.

Hi-Speedroid Clear Wing Rider shuffles WIND monsters from your GY into the Deck to destroy that many cards your opponent controls, and tributes itself during the opponent's Main Phase to Special Summon two Level 7 WIND Synchro Monsters from your Extra Deck.
Hi-Speedroid Kitedrake destroys all other cards on the field upon Synchro Summon, or negates the effects of all face-up cards your opponent controls.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder destroys opposing cards up to the number of different monster Types among your WIND Synchro Monsters, and banishes itself from GY to blink a WIND Synchro when the opponent Special Summons.
Speedroid Dupligate banishes a WIND monster from your GY to return an opponent's card to the hand, and Special Summons itself as a Level 1 Tuner from the GY.
Speedroid Scratch discards a Speedroid card to search any Speedroid monster from your Deck.
Speedroid Wing Synchron destroys itself and another WIND Pendulum in the other scale to cheat out Clear Wing Synchro Dragon as a Synchro Summon.

main: Speedroid Terrortop
Special Summons itself from the hand if you control no monsters; on summon, searches another Speedroid monster.
Speedroid Taketomborg
Special Summons itself while you control a WIND monster; Tribute it to Special Summon a Speedroid Tuner from the Deck.
Speedroid Darumaknocker

Newest support. Sends a Speedroid card from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand. Sent from the field to the GY: searches a Speedroid Spell/Trap, and with a Clear Wing monster out, destroys a monster.
Speedroid Colonel Clackers
Pendulum Scale: banish a Speedroid from the GY to place a Speedroid Pendulum (Wing Synchron) from the Deck. Destroyed on the field: Special Summons a Colonel Clackers as a Tuner.
Speedroid Wing Synchron
Pendulum Scale: destroys itself and a Level 2 WIND Pendulum in the other Scale, such as Colonel Clackers, to bring out Clear Wing Synchro Dragon as a Synchro Summon.
Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice
Level 1 Tuner off Taketomborg; sets another Speedroid's Level from 1 to 6 so the Synchro climbs land exactly.
Speedroid Ultra Hound
Normal Summoned: sends a Speedroid card from the Deck to the GY. From the GY: trades a Speedroid in the GY for a Speedroid Synchro of the same Level.
Speedroid Double Yoyo
Normal Summoned: revives a Level 3 or lower Speedroid.
Speedroid Marble Machine
Normal Summoned: searches a Speedroid monster. Also a Level 2 WIND Pendulum for Wing Synchron.
Speedroid Scratch
Sends a Speedroid card from the hand to the GY to search a Speedroid monster.
Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder

Destroys opposing cards, one for each different Type among your WIND Synchros (Clear Wing Dragons plus Hi-Speedroid Machines make two). From the GY: banishes and returns a WIND Synchro when the opponent Special Summons.
Speedroid Dupligate
Banishes a WIND monster from the GY to return an opposing card to the hand. Once per Duel it comes back from the GY as a Level 1 Tuner.
extra: Clear Wing Synchro Dragon
Wing Synchron's target. Negates Level 5 or higher monster effects and effects that target them.
Crystal Clear Wing Synchro Dragon
Tuner Synchro (Cork Shooter) + Clear Wing: negates Spells/Traps and shrugs off monster effects.
Crystal Clear Wing Over Synchro Dragon
Glider #2 + Clear Wing: negates any card or effect, and replaces itself with a Clear Wing if the opponent removes it.
Clear Wing Fast Dragon
Level 7 WIND Synchro that zeroes and negates an Extra Deck monster on either turn.
Hi-Speedroid Glider #2
Level 5 Synchro Tuner: revives a Level 7 or lower WIND Synchro, and from the GY raises the opponent's monsters' Levels into Clear Wing's range.
Hi-Speedroid Cork Shooter
Level 3 Synchro Tuner: searches a Speedroid Spell/Trap or revives its Speedroid materials.
Hi-Speedroid Clear Wing Rider
Level 11: shuffles WIND monsters from the GY to destroy that many opposing cards, and splits into two Level 7 WIND Synchros on the opponent's turn.
Hi-Speedroid Kitedrake
Level 8 for a WIND Machine Tuner: destroys every other card on the field or negates the opponent's face-up cards.
Hi-Speedroid Puzzle
Level 4 Speedroid Synchro for Ultra Hound off Darumaknocker or Marble Machine; gets a Speedroid back at the End Phase.
Hi-Speedroid Rubber Band Shooter
WIND Link-2: an extra Normal Summon, and a Speedroid search sized to a Synchro in the Extra Deck.
